source: Approved design sheet: 'bin-go Color and Type v3' (claude.ai/design project e72fe31c). Supersedes the Sprout/Harbor/Clay + Manrope/Inter system (version 1).

logo.rule: Always lowercase with the middle dot in accent green. No title case, no hyphen separator, no icon/symbol mark.

color.principle: One warm palette at two lightnesses. Green is the app accent AND the organics lid; blue, black and amber appear only as an answer, so a colour on screen always means a bin. Dark mode is not inverted: the cream darkens into umber, and every bin fill lifts to its lighter step so the answer card takes dark ink.

bins.note: Each bin has a fill (with the ink that sits on it) and a tint (with its tint ink). Keyed by the sheet's lid role; BIN_ROLE in brand.ts maps bingoDB's BinType onto these.

green.meaning: Organics, food, soiled paper. Also the app accent.

blue.meaning: Recycling — metal, plastic, card. Answer only.

black.meaning: Garbage — everything with no home. Answer only.

amber.meaning: Take-back / answer + caution — batteries, bulbs, depot glass. Answer only.

alert.role: Errors only — the toast banner and swipe-to-remove. Not on the sheet; a warm brick that sits in the palette without being any bin's colour. Amber is a bin, so an error must never borrow it. Same fill in both themes.

scanSurface.note: The scan screen is the only permanently dark surface, in both themes.

display.usage: The one-word answer (50px), screen titles (32px), section titles (36px). Always negatively tracked (-0.025 to -0.04em).

heading.usage: List titles (17px), card headlines (19px), the item name (26px), every button label (15px).

utility.usage: ONLY data quoted from a rulebook: provenance stamps, dates, hex codes, section eyebrows. Uppercase, tracked 0.08–0.12em, 10–12px. Body copy is never mono.

lid.description: The only illustration in the system. A bin is a rounded vertical bar (8–12 wide, 20–36 tall, 3 radius) in its lid colour; a row of them describes a region's bin set.

icons.rule: Only functional glyphs: search, camera, chevrons, close, plus, check, info. No filled icons, no icon fonts, no emoji, no drawings of bins.

elevation.shadowCard: 0 14px 34px rgba(46,43,37,0.18) light / rgba(0,0,0,0.5) dark — reserved for sheets and modals. Everything else is separated by a 1px line.

binAnswer.eyebrow: 'Goes in' in mono micro at 80% opacity

motion: 120–140ms ease on colour and toggle position only. No bounce, no parallax, no entrance animations.

voice.tone: Calm, second-person, specific. Reassurance comes from naming the bin, not from tone.
rules: Order is fixed: bin → reason → exception.
Sentence case everywhere. Uppercase only in mono stamps.
Uncertainty is stated plainly as a named condition, never hedged ('probably', 'we think').
No exclamation marks, no emoji, no mascot, no puns on the name.
voice.yes: Green bin. Greasy card can't be recycled here.

excluded: Gradients, photography, patterns (except the viewfinder stripe)
Drawings or icons of bins/trash, mascots, illustrated characters
Blur, frosted glass, inner shadows, glows
Blue/black/amber anywhere that isn't a bin answer
